## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (61%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
- InSitu (38%) remains in the 90% conformal set on this simulated frozen section, with 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 61%, InSitu 38%, Benign 1%, Invasive 0% | Split between Normal and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot rule out InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 90th OOD percentile, 12 tiles kept [F6] | Unflagged input; modest error AUROC (0.70) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class (true) | Independent backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (87%–89%); contrast Benign (84%) [F5] | Nearest neighbors all labeled Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Strongest score (-1.24), but 0/20 AI spot-check makes it unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 3, 6) · context · Above-typical score (-0.88); 8/20 AI spot-check, differs from Benign contrast [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.33), but 0/20 AI spot-check makes it unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 10) · ↓ invasive · Modest pull away from invasion (-0.23); 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Small pull toward invasion (+0.19); 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.011, CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified versus random deletion (+0.001, CI -0.009–0.006); case leans on unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (both 0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- True InSitu (38% probability) or ductal atypia is present, as flagged by the drafted deeper-levels order.
- Simulated composite frozen-section artifacts mislead the classifier (ECE 5%, CI 4%–22% across 24 patients; HoVer-Net cells disabled).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 4, 1**: Highest heatmap risk tiles (0.007, 0.006, 0.004); verify region 4 lacks stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 6**: Check ducts and lymphocytes for InSitu (38%); review drafted deeper-levels order (stains blocked).
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Confirm normal lobules directly (unreliable concept); check clear call on inferior/lateral margins (65%/64%) [F7].
